Messages.Author: yurian
Messages.Body:
hello all,

I am working on a deck using Ayes, and stepped into this card:  Static Virtue . At first glance, I thought it could be quite useful; a master card that under given circumstances would allow searching for 2 or 3 Ayes in the library, and place them on a vampire who moved to ready region in the previous turn... Yet, in checking the ruling, I saw this card only allows for placement of Aye+Orun in pairs (not either one or the other); so no real use in my deck, not in any other I can think of given its rather exceptional / situational circumstances.
Question I have is whether Static Virtue has ever been revised? Or will it get any consideration to eventually "upgrade" it to make it useful? As it currently stands, I admit I see no other use for the card than as a back for a proxy ... considering the little & situational use of Ayes and Oruns, a revision of Static Virtue would eventually be of help.
Thanks!

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> yurian wrote:
> Question I have is whether Static Virtue has ever been revised?
>
No

> yurian wrote:
> Or will it get any consideration to eventually "upgrade" it to make it useful? As it currently stands, I admit I see no other use for the card than as a back for a proxy ... considering the little & situational use of Ayes and Oruns, a revision of Static Virtue would eventually be of help.
> Thanks!
>
This is not a rule question, and I have frankly no idea if the card will ever be changed.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: yurian
Messages.Body:
hi Ankha,
True - the latter part of the ask was not a rules question; only the former ask for whether text was ever / would ever be reviewed. And that got answered!
Thanks
